checks.name: relation L_{i+1} L_i = q^2 L_i L_{i+1}, i in Z/5
relation L_{i+1} L_{i-1} = 1 + q L_i, i in Z/5

cyclic notation L_{i+5} = L_i (labels reduce mod 5)
canonical basis: L_i^a L_{i+1}^b = q^{-ab} L_{i;a,b}, 1 <= a,b <= 4, all i
pure powers: L_i^{a-1} L_i = L_i^a is a basis element, a <= 5

rho(L_{i;a,b}) = L_{i+2;a,b} on the window a+b <= 3
